data.title: 阿尔法 · 夜幕残垣的史莱姆剑弧
data.description: 荒凉的古代神殿废墟石柱间，阿尔法单手反握流动着暗金色魔力的史莱姆光刃，身姿凌厉轻盈，金发在强风中飞舞，蓝眸锐利地注视着前方战场。
data.location: ancient ruined stone sanctuary under a stormy dusk sky
data.action: poised in a dynamic low combat stance, brandishing a sleek black slime blade with golden magical aura, golden hair fluttering in gusting wind
data.lighting: dramatic rim lighting from glowing magical blade contrasting with dusky storm clouds
data.mood: fierce combat grace, overwhelming tactical supremacy, breathtaking power
data.promptProse: In ancient ruins, blonde elf Alpha in black bodysuit holds a magical slime sword in a poised combat stance as wind whips her hair.
data.animaCaption: Alpha ready to unleash devastating slime sword art amidst ancient ruins.
